title: AppMcpProposal (mcp-designer agent output)
$comment: DESIGN-ONLY. Transcribes the `AppMcpProposal` Rust struct at LOCAL-APP-PLUGIN-DESIGN-V2.md §12.4 (lines ~1535-1569), which does not exist in code yet (grepped `AppMcpProposal`/`AppMcpToolProposal`/`RequiredFlowChange`/`ExcludedCapability`; zero hits anywhere in the repo). §12.4's Rust block only names `tools: Vec<AppMcpToolProposal>`, `required_flow_changes: Vec<RequiredFlowChange>`, `excluded_capabilities: Vec<ExcludedCapability>` without spelling out those three item types; their shapes below are inferred from the surrounding prose (§12.4's bulleted 'Agent 只提议' list, §12.2's flow description, §12.3's tool quality gate, §13.2's tool schema limits) and are flagged per-field as inferred rather than sourced from a struct. §12.4 is explicit that server identity, connection scope, final Flow ID/build binding, annotations, icons, execution, _meta, permission ceiling, rate limit/timeout, and catalog digest are ALL Host-derived and the agent may not set them — none of those fields appear in this schema, on purpose.

app_id.$comment: BUILT field name/concept — §12.4 struct field `app_id: String`.

user_goal_sha256.$comment: §12.4 struct field `user_goal_sha256: String`; hex-64 pattern inferred from every other *_sha256 field this design doc defines the same way (e.g. runtime_profile.contract_sha256, validated in lingxi-code/tools/workflow/src/local_app_workflow_core.js:111).

tools.$comment: §12.4 struct field `tools: Vec<AppMcpToolProposal>`. minItems 1 / maxItems 16 is the published-App tool count bound from §1.7 ('1–16 tools') and §13.2 ('单 App 1–16 tools'); §12.3 states an authoring pass producing zero meaningful tools returns `mcp_authoring_required` instead of an empty proposal, so this schema treats an empty tools array as invalid rather than modeling that recoverable outcome — the workflow-level `mcp_authoring_required` path is a separate control-flow branch, not a shape this proposal schema represents.

items.$comment: AppMcpToolProposal — INFERRED shape. §12.4's 'Agent 只提议' bullet list names name/title/description, inputSchema/outputSchema, and a 'business Flow semantic reference' (not the full Host-validated AppMcpFlowBinding of §12.5, which the agent cannot construct because final Flow ID binding is Host-derived per §12.4's exclusion list). name/title/description length limits are §13.2's Local App tool schema limits, applied here even though §13.2 states those are the HOST's product budget on the generated catalog rather than a proposal-time contract — enforcing them at proposal time is this schema's choice to fail fast, not a requirement §13.2 itself states for the proposal stage.

name.$comment: §13.2: canonical lower snake case, 1-64 chars, no leading/trailing/consecutive underscore.

input_schema.$comment: §12.4: agent proposes inputSchema. §13.2 bounds it at 32 KiB / depth 8 with a closed object root and no remote $ref — not enforced by this JSON Schema's own type system (JSON Schema cannot size- or depth-bound an arbitrary sub-schema value it hosts) and left as a note for the Host validator §8.3/§12.2 describes, not something this file can gate.

output_schema.$comment: §12.4: agent proposes outputSchema (optional per §13.1's McpToolDefinitionDto.output_schema: Option<Value>, the partially-built wire DTO at lingxi-code/platform-api/src/mcp.rs:213-232 that this eventually composes into — that struct currently lacks title/output_schema/annotations/execution/icons/meta/effective_max_permission, matching the design table's note that platform-api/src/mcp.rs 'lacks standard Tool fields').

flow_reference.$comment: INFERRED. §12.4 calls this a '业务 Flow semantic reference', distinct from the fully-typed `AppMcpFlowBinding` of §12.5 (flow_id/inputs/result with FlowValueBinding) which Host validation produces only after promotion — the agent cannot emit a validated AppMcpFlowBinding per §12.4's own exclusion list. Modeled here as an opaque free-text reference the mcp-flow-binding skill and Host resolve later; no concrete shape for it exists in the design doc.

required_flow_changes.$comment: §12.4 struct field `required_flow_changes: Vec<RequiredFlowChange>`; `RequiredFlowChange`'s own fields are not spelled out anywhere in the design doc or code (grepped; zero hits) — item shape below is the minimum §12.2's flow ('required_flow_changes? builder + refresh evidence + rerun') implies: something identifying which Flow and what change, plus why. Flagged INFERRED, not sourced.

excluded_capabilities.$comment: §12.4 struct field `excluded_capabilities: Vec<ExcludedCapability>`; `ExcludedCapability`'s own fields are not spelled out anywhere either. §12.3 says a zero-meaningful-tool authoring pass '把原因写入 excluded_capabilities' (writes the reason here), which is the only concrete constraint the design gives this type — modeled below as {capability, reason}. Flagged INFERRED, not sourced.
